diff --git a/durability.go b/durability.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..32e1d132
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability.go
@@ -0,0 +1,428 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"container/heap"
+	"context"
+	"reflect"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+)
+
+// ErrDurabilityJobExpired is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the
+// requested job ID has fallen out of the bounded window of retained
+// BatchDurable jobs.
+var ErrDurabilityJobExpired = errors.New("pebble: durability job expired")
+
+// ErrDurabilityJobUnknown is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the
+// requested job ID was never assigned to a BatchDurable event.
+var ErrDurabilityJobUnknown = errors.New("pebble: unknown durability job")
+
+// ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions is delivered on the channel returned by
+// DB.DurabilityNotify when the number of outstanding subscriptions exceeds
+// the bound.
+var ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions = errors.New("pebble: too many outstanding durability subscriptions")
+
+const (
+	// durableJobRetention is the number of most recent BatchDurable jobs whose
+	// outcome is retained for DB.WaitForJobDurability.
+	durableJobRetention = 1024
+	// maxDurabilitySubscriptions bounds the number of outstanding (unfired)
+	// DB.DurabilityNotify subscriptions.
+	maxDurabilitySubscriptions = 1 << 16
+)
+
+// DurabilityStats is a snapshot of the durability state of a DB, returned by
+// DB.DurabilityStats.
+type DurabilityStats struct {
+	// HighestDurableSeqNum is the highest sequence number known to be durable
+	// in the WAL as a result of a Sync commit.
+	HighestDurableSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	// FirstErr is the first WAL sync error observed by a Sync commit.
+	FirstErr error
+	// PendingWaiters is the number of goroutines currently blocked in one of
+	// the DB.WaitFor* durability APIs.
+	PendingWaiters int64
+	// TotalDurableCommits is the number of Sync commits whose WAL sync
+	// succeeded.
+	TotalDurableCommits uint64
+	// TotalFailedCommits is the number of Sync commits whose WAL sync failed.
+	TotalFailedCommits uint64
+	// CumulativeSyncDuration is the cumulative WAL sync phase duration of all
+	// Sync commits.
+	CumulativeSyncDuration time.Duration
+	// MaxSyncDuration is the maximum WAL sync phase duration of any Sync
+	// commit.
+	MaxSyncDuration time.Duration
+}
+
+// durabilityWaiter is a goroutine blocked in a wait API, or an outstanding
+// DurabilityNotify subscription.
+type durabilityWaiter struct {
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	// ch is buffered with capacity 1 and receives exactly one value.
+	ch chan error
+	// index is the position in the heap, or -1 if not in the heap.
+	index        int
+	subscription bool
+}
+
+type durabilityWaiterHeap []*durabilityWaiter
+
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Len() int           { return len(h) }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Less(i, j int) bool { return h[i].seqNum < h[j].seqNum }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Swap(i, j int) {
+	h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i]
+	h[i].index = i
+	h[j].index = j
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Push(x any) {
+	w := x.(*durabilityWaiter)
+	w.index = len(*h)
+	*h = append(*h, w)
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Pop() any {
+	old := *h
+	n := len(old)
+	w := old[n-1]
+	old[n-1] = nil
+	w.index = -1
+	*h = old[:n-1]
+	return w
+}
+
+type durableJob struct {
+	id  JobID
+	err error
+}
+
+// durabilityTracker tracks the durability of Sync commits and the goroutines
+// waiting on it.
+type durabilityTracker struct {
+	// walDisabled is set when Options.DisableWAL is true, in which case all
+	// wait APIs return immediately.
+	walDisabled bool
+	// listenerConfigured is true if the user configured
+	// EventListener.BatchDurable.
+	listenerConfigured bool
+
+	pendingWaiters atomic.Int64
+
+	mu struct {
+		sync.Mutex
+		highest   base.SeqNum
+		firstErr  error
+		closedErr error
+		waiters   durabilityWaiterHeap
+		numSubs   int
+		nextJobID JobID
+		jobs      [durableJobRetention]durableJob
+
+		totalDurable uint64
+		totalFailed  uint64
+		cumSync      time.Duration
+		maxSync      time.Duration
+
+		// Accumulated only when listenerConfigured.
+		metricsCount    uint64
+		metricsDuration time.Duration
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) init(walDisabled bool, el *EventListener) {
+	t.walDisabled = walDisabled
+	t.listenerConfigured = el != nil && el.BatchDurable != nil && !isNoopBatchDurable(el.BatchDurable)
+	t.mu.nextJobID = 1
+}
+
+// resultLocked returns whether a wait for seqNum can complete and, if so,
+// with what error.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) resultLocked(seqNum base.SeqNum) (bool, error) {
+	switch {
+	case t.walDisabled || seqNum <= t.mu.highest:
+		return true, nil
+	case t.mu.firstErr != nil:
+		return true, t.mu.firstErr
+	case t.mu.closedErr != nil:
+		return true, t.mu.closedErr
+	}
+	return false, nil
+}
+
+// complete records the outcome of a Sync commit whose last sequence number is
+// lastSeqNum, waking any waiters it satisfies, and returns the job ID assigned
+// to the commit.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) complete(
+	lastSeqNum base.SeqNum, syncDuration time.Duration, err error,
+) JobID {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	jobID := t.mu.nextJobID
+	t.mu.nextJobID++
+	t.mu.jobs[int(jobID)%durableJobRetention] = durableJob{id: jobID, err: err}
+
+	t.mu.cumSync += syncDuration
+	t.mu.maxSync = max(t.mu.maxSync, syncDuration)
+	if t.listenerConfigured {
+		t.mu.metricsCount++
+		t.mu.metricsDuration += syncDuration
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		t.mu.totalFailed++
+		if t.mu.firstErr == nil {
+			t.mu.firstErr = err
+		}
+		t.failAllLocked(t.mu.firstErr)
+		return jobID
+	}
+	t.mu.totalDurable++
+	if lastSeqNum > t.mu.highest {
+		t.mu.highest = lastSeqNum
+	}
+	for len(t.mu.waiters) > 0 && t.mu.waiters[0].seqNum <= t.mu.highest {
+		t.fireLocked(heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter), nil)
+	}
+	return jobID
+}
+
+// close fails all current waiters and causes future waits for sequence
+// numbers that are not yet durable to fail with err.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) close(err error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if t.mu.closedErr == nil {
+		t.mu.closedErr = err
+	}
+	t.failAllLocked(firstError(t.mu.firstErr, t.mu.closedErr))
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) failAllLocked(err error) {
+	for len(t.mu.waiters) > 0 {
+		t.fireLocked(heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter), err)
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) fireLocked(w *durabilityWaiter, err error) {
+	if w.subscription {
+		t.mu.numSubs--
+	}
+	w.ch <- err
+}
+
+// wait blocks until seqNum is durable, a durability error is latched, the DB
+// is closed, or ctx is done.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) wait(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	if done, err := t.resultLocked(seqNum); done {
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	w := &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: make(chan error, 1)}
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, w)
+	t.pendingWaiters.Add(1)
+	t.mu.Unlock()
+	defer t.pendingWaiters.Add(-1)
+
+	select {
+	case err := <-w.ch:
+		return err
+	case <-ctx.Done():
+	}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	if w.index >= 0 {
+		heap.Remove(&t.mu.waiters, w.index)
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return ctx.Err()
+	}
+	t.mu.Unlock()
+	// The waiter was fired concurrently with the context being done; prefer
+	// the durability outcome.
+	return <-w.ch
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) notify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	ch := make(chan error, 1)
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if done, err := t.resultLocked(seqNum); done {
+		ch <- err
+		return ch
+	}
+	if t.mu.numSubs >= maxDurabilitySubscriptions {
+		ch <- ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions
+		return ch
+	}
+	t.mu.numSubs++
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: ch, subscription: true})
+	return ch
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) jobResult(jobID JobID) error {
+	if t.walDisabled {
+		return nil
+	}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if jobID <= 0 || jobID >= t.mu.nextJobID {
+		return errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobUnknown, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+	}
+	j := t.mu.jobs[int(jobID)%durableJobRetention]
+	if j.id != jobID {
+		return errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobExpired, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+	}
+	return j.err
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) state() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return t.mu.highest, t.mu.firstErr
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) stats() DurabilityStats {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return DurabilityStats{
+		HighestDurableSeqNum:   t.mu.highest,
+		FirstErr:               t.mu.firstErr,
+		PendingWaiters:         t.pendingWaiters.Load(),
+		TotalDurableCommits:    t.mu.totalDurable,
+		TotalFailedCommits:     t.mu.totalFailed,
+		CumulativeSyncDuration: t.mu.cumSync,
+		MaxSyncDuration:        t.mu.maxSync,
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) metrics() (uint64, time.Duration) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return t.mu.metricsCount, t.mu.metricsDuration
+}
+
+// noopBatchDurable is the default BatchDurable handler installed by
+// EventListener.EnsureDefaults. It is distinguished from user-provided
+// handlers so that durability metrics are only accumulated when a handler has
+// been configured.
+func noopBatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo) {}
+
+var noopBatchDurablePtr = reflect.ValueOf(noopBatchDurable).Pointer()
+
+func isNoopBatchDurable(f func(BatchDurableInfo)) bool {
+	return reflect.ValueOf(f).Pointer() == noopBatchDurablePtr
+}
+
+// reportBatchDurable is invoked exactly once per Sync commit once its WAL
+// sync has completed (successfully or not).
+func (d *DB) reportBatchDurable(b *Batch, err error) {
+	bd := &b.durability
+	if bd.syncStart == 0 {
+		// The batch was never written to the WAL.
+		return
+	}
+	syncDuration := bd.syncStart.Elapsed()
+	bd.syncStart = 0
+	// Durations are measured with a monotonic clock; guard against a
+	// pathologically coarse clock reporting a zero duration.
+	syncDuration = max(syncDuration, time.Nanosecond)
+	applyDuration := max(bd.applyDuration, time.Nanosecond)
+
+	seqNum := b.SeqNum()
+	lastSeqNum := seqNum + base.SeqNum(bd.keyCount)
+	if lastSeqNum > 0 {
+		lastSeqNum--
+	}
+	jobID := d.durability.complete(lastSeqNum, syncDuration, err)
+	d.opts.EventListener.BatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo{
+		JobID:         int(jobID),
+		SeqNum:        seqNum,
+		Err:           err,
+		ApplyDuration: applyDuration,
+		SyncDuration:  syncDuration,
+		CorrelationID: bd.correlationID,
+		BatchSize:     bd.batchSize,
+		KeyCount:      bd.keyCount,
+	})
+}
+
+// WaitForDurability blocks until the provided sequence number is durable in
+// the WAL, a WAL sync fails, or the DB is closed. A sequence number of zero is
+// always considered durable. If the WAL is disabled, it returns nil
+// immediately.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurability(seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(context.Background(), seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityContext is like WaitForDurability, but also returns if ctx
+// is done. Durability and close errors take precedence over context errors.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatch blocks until every provided sequence number is
+// durable. See WaitForDurability.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatch(seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(context.Background(), seqNums)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatchContext is like WaitForDurabilityBatch, but also
+// returns if ctx is done.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(ctx context.Context, seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	if len(seqNums) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	// WAL syncs are ordered, so the durability of the largest sequence number
+	// implies the durability of all smaller ones.
+	var maxSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	for _, s := range seqNums {
+		maxSeqNum = max(maxSeqNum, s)
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, maxSeqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurability returns the durability outcome of the Sync commit
+// reported to EventListener.BatchDurable with the given job ID. Only a bounded
+// number of recent jobs are retained; older jobs return an error wrapping
+// ErrDurabilityJobExpired. Job IDs that were never reported (including zero)
+// return an error wrapping ErrDurabilityJobUnknown.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurability(jobID int) error {
+	return d.WaitForJobDurabilityContext(context.Background(), jobID)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurabilityContext is like WaitForJobDurability, but also returns
+// if ctx is done.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, jobID int) error {
+	// Jobs are only recorded once their WAL sync has completed, so the outcome
+	// is always known and there is nothing to block on.
+	return d.durability.jobResult(JobID(jobID))
+}
+
+// DurableState returns the highest sequence number known to be durable and
+// the first latched WAL sync error, if any.
+func (d *DB) DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	return d.durability.state()
+}
+
+// DurabilityNotify returns a channel that receives exactly one value: nil once
+// seqNum is durable, or a non-nil error if a WAL sync fails or the DB is
+// closed first. The channel is buffered, so the caller need not receive from
+// it. If too many subscriptions are outstanding, the returned channel
+// immediately delivers an error.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityNotify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	return d.durability.notify(seqNum)
+}
+
+// DurabilityStats returns a snapshot of the DB's durability statistics.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats {
+	return d.durability.stats()
+}
diff --git a/durability_test.go b/durability_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..187634a8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,251 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"sync"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/vfs"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+type batchDurableRecorder struct {
+	mu    sync.Mutex
+	infos []BatchDurableInfo
+}
+
+func (r *batchDurableRecorder) record(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	r.infos = append(r.infos, info)
+}
+
+func (r *batchDurableRecorder) get() []BatchDurableInfo {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	return append([]BatchDurableInfo(nil), r.infos...)
+}
+
+func openDurabilityTestDB(t *testing.T, el *EventListener, disableWAL bool) *DB {
+	opts := &Options{
+		FS:            vfs.NewMem(),
+		EventListener: el,
+		DisableWAL:    disableWAL,
+		Logger:        testutilsLogger{t},
+	}
+	d, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return d
+}
+
+type testutilsLogger struct{ t *testing.T }
+
+func (l testutilsLogger) Infof(format string, args ...interface{})  { l.t.Logf(format, args...) }
+func (l testutilsLogger) Errorf(format string, args ...interface{}) { l.t.Logf(format, args...) }
+func (l testutilsLogger) Fatalf(format string, args ...interface{}) { l.t.Fatalf(format, args...) }
+
+func TestBatchDurable(t *testing.T) {
+	var r batchDurableRecorder
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, &EventListener{BatchDurable: r.record}, false)
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, d.Close()) }()
+
+	// Non-sync commits do not fire.
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), NoSync))
+	require.Empty(t, r.get())
+
+	b := d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("b"), []byte("2"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("c"), []byte("3"), nil))
+	size := len(b.Repr())
+	require.NoError(t, d.Apply(b, &WriteOptions{Sync: true, CommitCorrelationID: 42}))
+	seqNum := b.SeqNum()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+
+	infos := r.get()
+	require.Len(t, infos, 1)
+	info := infos[0]
+	require.NoError(t, info.Err)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, info.JobID)
+	require.Equal(t, seqNum, info.SeqNum)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(42), info.CorrelationID)
+	require.Equal(t, size, info.BatchSize)
+	require.Equal(t, uint32(2), info.KeyCount)
+	require.Greater(t, info.ApplyDuration, time.Duration(0))
+	require.Greater(t, info.SyncDuration, time.Duration(0))
+
+	// ApplyNoSyncWait fires from SyncWait.
+	b = d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("d"), []byte("4"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, d.ApplyNoSyncWait(b, Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, b.SyncWait())
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+	require.Len(t, r.get(), 2)
+
+	highest, err := d.DurableState()
+	require.NoError(t, err)

+	require.Greater(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration, time.Duration(0))
+	require.GreaterOrEqual(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration, stats.MaxSyncDuration)

+	require.Equal(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration, m.DurableCommitDuration)

+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(2))
+	require.ErrorContains(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(0), "unknown")
+	require.ErrorContains(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(3), "unknown")

+func TestWaitForDurability(t *testing.T) {
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, &EventListener{}, false)
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, d.Close()) }()
+
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(0))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch(nil))
+
+	// A non-sync commit is not durable until a subsequent sync commit.
+	b := d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, d.Apply(b, NoSync))
+	noSyncSeq := b.SeqNum()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+
+	ch := d.DurabilityNotify(noSyncSeq)
+	errCh := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() { errCh <- d.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{noSyncSeq, 1}) }()
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters == 1 },
+		10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, noSyncSeq), context.DeadlineExceeded)
+
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("b"), []byte("2"), Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, <-errCh)
+	require.NoError(t, <-ch)
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(noSyncSeq))
+	require.Zero(t, d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters)
+
+	// An already-durable sequence number takes precedence over a cancelled
+	// context.
+	cancelled, cancel2 := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel2()
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(cancelled, noSyncSeq))
+}

+		10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+	require.NoError(t, d.Close())

+func TestDurabilityTrackerErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	var tr durabilityTracker
+	tr.init(false, nil)
+	ch := tr.notify(20)
+	tr.complete(10, time.Millisecond, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, tr.wait(context.Background(), 10))
+
+	syncErr := errors.New("sync failed")
+	jobID := tr.complete(20, 2*time.Millisecond, syncErr)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-ch, syncErr)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, tr.wait(context.Background(), 20), syncErr)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, tr.jobResult(jobID), syncErr)
+	highest, err := tr.state()
+	require.Equal(t, base.SeqNum(10), highest)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, syncErr)
+
+	s := tr.stats()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), s.TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), s.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Equal(t, 3*time.Millisecond, s.CumulativeSyncDuration)
+	require.Equal(t, 2*time.Millisecond, s.MaxSyncDuration)
+}

+func TestDurabilityNotifyBound(t *testing.T) {
+	var tr durabilityTracker
+	tr.init(false, nil)
+	for i := 0; i < maxDurabilitySubscriptions; i++ {
+		tr.notify(100)
+	}
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-tr.notify(100), ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions)
+	tr.complete(100, time.Millisecond, nil)
+	require.NoError(t, <-tr.notify(50))
+	ch := tr.notify(200)
+	tr.close(ErrClosed)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-ch, ErrClosed)
+}
